thread:
maria: heads-up — eu-central GPU queues spiking for model mosaic-xl-q4. queue depth ~3x in last 15m, tail latency creeping up. anyone else seeing this? :eyes:

raj: saw the alert. admission control engaged but backlog still grew. throttled tokens ~30% for that model.

ops-bot: Alert: eu-central queue_depth=512 model=mosaic-xl-q4 avg_latency=1.82s dropped=0

liam: p95 network to kv-cache nodes increased ~2x around the same time. could be cache miss storm -> extra compute.

sophia: pod check: not crashlooping. GPU util ~98% on most mosaic-xl replicas, CPU high, no OOMs.

maria: timeline note — spike started ~15:02 UTC right after canary rollout of v2-quant for mosaic-xl-q4. that variant is slower on long sequences.

raj: confirmed. v2-quant shows ~10% higher per-token exec time on test harness for sequences >1024. admission calc still using old throughput estimate.

liam: quick mitigations I suggest:
- rollback the canary (if rollback risk acceptable)
- adjust admission-control capacity for mosaic-xl-q4 down for non-enterprise traffic
- route low-priority/free traffic to mosaic-1-small fallback

sophia: rollback will take ~8-10m and may cause transient 503s while pods terminate.

maria: priority: keep enterprise SLA intact (routes tagged enterprise-tier / customers like acme-inc). free/low-priority traffic can be sacrificed.

raj: I'll push a hotfix to admission-control: reduce tokens for model:mosaic-xl-q4 for routes without enterprise header, and make admission aware of variant (v2-quant) CPU/GPU profile. will also enable short-lived prefix caching to cut repeated compute.

liam: I'll create a routing patch: any request with header `x-customer-tier=free` -> mosaic-1-small; add burst token bucket (100 reqs/min) to smooth the spike. will also add a fallback rule for sequences >2048 to force quantized path.

ops-bot: Action logged: thread=1965432100 tasks={raj:patch_admission_control, liam:routing_patch, maria:rollback_decision_pending}

sophia: quick diagnostic dump:
```
# kubectl top pods -n prod | grep mosaic
mosaic-xl-q4-0   98m    99%   0/1
mosaic-xl-q4-1   102m   98%   0/1
mosaic-xl-q4-canary  110m 100%   0/1
mosaic-1-small-0  20m    12%   0/1
```

maria: ok plan: raj -> patch admission now; liam -> push routing change as soon as raj confirms; if metrics still bad at +5m we'll rollback canary. I'll coordinate with SRE on postmortem if rollback happens. :rocket:

raj: patch applied (hotfix v1). monitoring ingress tokens and queue depth. will post metrics in 2m.

liam: routing change staged, deploying in 30s.

ops-bot: Update: admission_patch applied at 15:07 UTC; routing_deploy at 15:08 UTC.

maria: monitoring shows queue depth stabilizing, p95 latency dropping. leaving this thread open for 30m then we'll close. thanks all. :thumbsup:
